items.title: Trump says agreement with Iran to reopen Strait of Hormuz 'could be soon'
items.content: President Trump said negotiations with Iran are continuing and an agreement on reopening the Strait of Hormuz, a key waterway connecting the Persian Gulf to the Gulf of Oman, could come in the near future. Markets have been trading on hopes of a deal since June's memorandum of understanding.

items.title: 2,500 US marines from 31st MEU arrive in Middle East as part of Hormuz reopening efforts
items.content: US marines from the 31st Marine Expeditionary Unit arrived in the Middle East, expected to be part of US efforts to open the Strait of Hormuz. Iran continues to assert hegemonic control over the strait despite the June MoU that seeks to reopen it and end the Iran war.

items.title: S&P 500 closes at record 7,758 as weak labor data trims Fed hike expectations
items.content: The S&P 500 rose 0.6% to a record close of 7,758, the Nasdaq gained 1.3%, and the Dow added 152 points. Gains led by Salesforce (+2.47%). Weaker-than-expected labor market data reduced expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike next month.

items.title: US June CPI expected to ease to 3.8% from 4.2%, first slowdown in five months
items.content: The annual inflation rate in the US is expected to ease to 3.8% in June 2026 from 4.2% in May, marking its first slowdown in five months after reaching its highest level since April 2023. Headline PCE over the year through June was 3.7%, up 1.1pp from a year earlier, with energy price swings a large contributor.

items.title: Earnings calendar for week of August 10-14
items.content: Kiplinger published the weekly earnings calendar of the most important upcoming quarterly reports scheduled for August 10-14, as Q2 earnings season winds down.

items.title: Hang Seng opens marginally lower as AIA and HSBC decline while Alibaba rises
items.content: Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index opened three points down at 25,526 on 7 August 2026, with AIA and HSBC both seeing early losses, but technology stocks like Alibaba and NetEase recording gains.

items.title: Hong Kong shares seen consolidating just above 25,530 plateau
items.content: The Hang Seng Index advanced almost 1,050 points or 4.2% recently and now sits just above the 25,530-point plateau, expected to see continued consolidation on Friday.

items.title: US stocks sway in mixed trading as more earnings reports roll in
items.content: Warner Bros. Discovery rose 1.3% after reporting earnings ahead of expectations; Molson Coors rose 1.8% after encouraging results. Stocks held close to records while oil prices held steady.

items.title: China stocks rise as AI, chip shares rebound sharply
items.content: Shanghai Composite up 0.3% at 3,822.28; CSI 300 rose 1.3%. ChiNext Price Index climbed 5.7% and STAR 50 Index up 4.1%. China's CSI Artificial Intelligence Index rose 5.9% on renewed sector optimism.

items.title: China stocks rebound on AI, chip rally; Alibaba gains on new AI model
items.content: Chinese stocks rebounded Tuesday led by AI and semiconductor shares after a Monday global AI selloff dragged chipmakers. Hong Kong's technology sector outperformed, with Alibaba rallying on its new AI model.

items.title: Iran continues Hormuz talks with Oman; US signals optimism on deal
items.content: Iran's goal in current talks with Oman is to set temporary arrangements - lasting up to three months - where they can control a route through the critical waterway. The S&P 500 hit a record high on hopes for progress on reopening the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: S&P 500 back at record high; Dow hits 54,000
items.content: The S&P 500 closed at a record high supported by strong corporate earnings, a rebound in tech shares and traders embracing hopes for progress on reopening the Strait of Hormuz. S&P 500 closed at 7,736.52 (+1.80%) on Aug 4.
